config.message_file_download: Controls whether users are allowed to download original files. When disabled, download buttons are hidden and files can only be viewed online.
config.message_guest_access:
Guest access is a mode where anyone can access {{ appName }} without password.
Like a normal user, the guest user can only access its documents and those accessible through permissions.
config.custom_css_placeholder: Custom CSS to add after the main stylesheet
config.message_ocr: OCR is a feature that extracts text from images and PDF files. This feature requires a working Tesseract installation on the server.
config.webhooks_explain: Webhooks will be called when the specified event occur. The given URL will be POST-ed with a JSON payload containing the event name and the ID of the concerned resource.
config.message_file_encrypt: Determines whether uploaded files are stored encrypted (AES-256) on the server disk. Note: This is a one-time initialization decision. Once locked or once any file is uploaded, it cannot be changed.
config.lock_encrypted_btn: Confirm & Lock: Enable AES-256 Encrypted Storage
config.file_encrypt_confirm_title: Confirm Permanent Lock of File Encryption Mode
config.file_encrypt_confirm_message:
You are about to set the file encryption mode to '{{ mode }}'.
Warning: Once confirmed, this setting will be permanently locked and can never be changed! Proceed?
config.first_time_encrypt_title: First-Time Setup: Choose File Storage Encryption Mode
config.first_time_encrypt_message:
Welcome to FormosaBearV! Before uploading files, please choose and lock the File Storage Mode (file.encrypt):

1. Unencrypted Storage (Recommended): Files are stored in their original format organized by user and document folders, making direct backup and maintenance easy.
2. AES-256 Encrypted Storage: All uploaded files are encrypted on disk and cannot be read directly from the filesystem.

⚠️ Warning: This setting is permanently locked after confirmation (or after the first file upload) and cannot be changed later!
config.message_file_delete: Controls whether deleting a file permanently removes the physical file from disk or moves it to the delete/storage recycle directory.
config.enable_file_delete: Switch to: Permanently Delete from Disk
config.disable_file_delete: Switch to: Move to Recycle Directory
config.message_file_duplicate: Controls whether the same user is allowed to upload multiple files with the same file name.
config.base_url_help: The root URL used by the system for email links and notifications (defaults to http://localhost:8080).
config.smtp_from_name_help: Sender display name and email subject prefix (falls back to application name if empty, defaults to FormosaBearV).
config.smtp_security_help: Select the security protocol required by your SMTP server. For local or intranet relays, select Plain text or Auto-detect.

You will be required to enter this validation code each time you login on {{ appName }}.

backup.title: System Database & Configuration Backup
backup.description: Backup and restore supporting H2 and PostgreSQL database metadata, tags, ACLs, full-text index, and security configurations. Physical storage files (storage/) are recommended to be backed up via host filesystem tools.
backup.export_explain: Click the button below to download a lightweight database and configuration backup archive (.zip, typically < 5 MB in a few seconds). It contains:
backup.explain_dump_sql: ANSI-standard SQL dump compatible with both H2 and PostgreSQL, including all users, metadata, tags, and ACLs.
backup.explain_config_json: Complete system configuration (encryption mode, soft delete, duplication, download permission, etc.).
backup.explain_manifest_json: System version and export metadata information.
backup.physical_storage_notice_msg: To prevent timeouts or connection drops when handling large storage sizes (e.g. tens or hundreds of GBs), physical document files are not packaged inside this web download. System administrators should directly back up the filesystem directory:
backup.downloading: Generating and downloading backup, please wait...
backup.warning_message: System restore will overwrite database tables and system configurations, followed by automatic background search re-indexing. If the backup archive does not include physical files, existing files on disk will be safely preserved. Please ensure you have selected the correct backup file.
backup.select_or_drag_file: Click to select or drag a backup ZIP file here
backup.zip_only: Only .zip backup archives generated by this system are supported
backup.click_to_change_file: Click to select a different file
backup.confirm_restore_prompt:
WARNING: You are about to restore database and configurations!

This will overwrite current database records and configurations, and rebuild search indexes in the background.
Existing storage files on disk will be preserved.
This action CANNOT be undone. Are you sure you want to proceed?
backup.uploading_and_restoring: Uploading and restoring backup archive, please do not close this window...
backup.restore_success_message: Database and system configurations have been successfully restored, and session tokens have been reset. You will be redirected to log in again to load the restored data.
backup.restore_failed_generic: An error occurred during upload or restoration. Please check file format and try again.
